sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: The Huntsman Path - Forest Cleaning is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Greetings. For years I've been hunting in these woods, and among other things, I've learned that animals are way more humane than humankind itself. When the conflict started, all that's left of those remains of humane in people just vanished entirely. There are so many monsters out there that I can't even imagine. Those are no longer people, nor they are animals, they are something way worse... We can't let them destroy our city, we have to sort this out. Deal with this, hunter."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Eliminate 50 Scavs on Streets of Tarkov, Reserve, Lighthouse, or Shoreline

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +28,000 EXP
- Jaeger Rep +0.75
- 275,000 Roubles
  - 288,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 316,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
- 1× Shustrilo sealing foam
"They made their choice when they stepped on the wrong path. You have done the right thing, hunter, thank you."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text: Kill 50 Scavs on Streets of Tarkov, Reserve, Lighthouse, or Shoreline.
